title: Splitting a bill exactly
description:
Write `final class Bill` with:

- `static List<BigDecimal> split(String amount, int people)`: split an amount like `"100.00"` into `people` parts with two decimals that add up **exactly** to the amount; the first parts get the extra pennies. `people` below 1 throws `IllegalArgumentException`.
- `static BigDecimal withTip(String amount, String percent)`: the amount plus the tip, rounded to 2 decimals with `RoundingMode.HALF_UP`.

```java
Bill.split("100.00", 3)          // [33.34, 33.33, 33.33]
Bill.withTip("84.50", "15")      // 97.18
```
hints: Work in whole pennies: `new BigDecimal(amount).setScale(2, ...).unscaledValue()` gives them as a `BigInteger`, and `divideAndRemainder` gives the share and the pennies left over, as an array `{quotient, remainder}` of two `BigInteger`s (lesson 8.04).
`new BigDecimal(pennies, 2)` turns a whole number of pennies back into an amount with two decimals.
